tools.hooks.friendly_summary: 6 hook options created in tone {tone} · Recommended hook: {angle} ({retention}% estimated retention)
tools.hooks.title: Hook Generator
tools.hooks.lede: Two lines, six angles. The hook is not an introduction: it is the immediate delivery of gold in the first seconds, with raw number, tension and second person.
tools.hooks.anatomy_tension_desc: something that can only be resolved by watching
tools.hooks.subject: Subject
tools.hooks.theme_placeholder: Ex.: investing R$100 per month in FIIs
tools.hooks.promise_hint: what the hook promises to deliver
tools.hooks.promise_placeholder: E.g.: the real income with the statement on the screen
tools.hooks.promise_desc: Promise enters the second row of the number, transformation, authority, and future angles.
tools.hooks.golden_rule_desc: never start with context. If the first sentence can be cut without losing information, it was born wrong.
tools.humanizador.paste_draft_placeholde: Paste the sketch to see the marks.
tools.humanizador.summary_short_clean: 🔍 Short sentence ({count} {wordLabel}) · Clean vocabulary, no AI marks · Insert more text to measure cadence and rhythm (Grade {score}/100)
tools.humanizador.summary_score_high: ✨ Highly authentic tone ({score}/100) · Spontaneous, cliché-free pacing AI
tools.humanizador.summary_score_mid: ⚖️ Intermediate Tone ({score}/100) · {hitsText}Sentences with monotonous rhythm, require more variation
tools.humanizador.summary_score_low: 🤖 Plaster Tom ({score}/100) · {hitsText}Recommended rewrite with a conversational tone
tools.humanizador.title: Humanizing
tools.humanizador.lede: Anti-robot filter. It detects broken AI vocabulary, measures the variation in sentence length (burstiness) and returns a rewritten version at a human pace — without losing your argument.
tools.humanizador.no_long_sentences: No sentences longer than 26 words. Preserved speech rhythm.
tools.humanizador.draft_placeholder: Paste here the text that came from ChatGPT or Claude
tools.humanizador.rule_1: Swap common vocabulary for conversational words
tools.humanizador.rule_2: Cuts opening crutches that do not carry information
tools.humanizador.rule_3: Maintains the argument and the original order of ideas
tools.humanizador.rule_4: Does not invent data or promise what the text does not deliver
tools.membros.friendly_summary: Projection of {members} members ({revenue}/month) · Model evaluated as {status}
tools.membros.title: Members Area
tools.membros.lede: Signature Teaching and Mathematics Architecture. Take the quiz and the panel calculates how many members your real audience supports — before you promise something you don't deliver.
tools.membros.realistic_desc: Within what is realistic: below 6% of the recurring base.
tools.membros.unrealistic_desc: Goal above what the current audience supports. Raise the price, cut the target or grow the base first.
tools.membros.promise_expl: A phrase, a transformation, a rhythm. If it takes two sentences, the promise is not yet clear.
tools.membros.churn_rule_desc: Member cancels when they cannot name what they received this month. Every module needs a deliverable with a name and date.
tools.mentor.signal_pack_adv: Before changing the video, change the showcase: 3 new titles and 2 thumbnails for the same theme. It is the cheapest test of the {n} framework.
tools.mentor.signal_ret_adv: Cut the first 20 seconds. If the hook doesn't deliver the thesis, the rest doesn't matter: retention drops before the content begins.
tools.mentor.signal_dist_adv: Compare to the theme's ceiling, not its average. If the ceiling is low, the problem is not execution — it is the choice of agenda.
tools.mentor.signal_aud_adv: Separate new, casual and recurring. Strategy for recurring is depth; for new is absolute clarity of the topic.
tools.mentor.signal_mon_adv: Monetization follows trust, not views. If the trust curve is still short, sell something cheap and quick to deliver.
tools.mentor.signal_sus_adv: Reduce scope before reducing frequency. A simpler format, done every week, beats an epic done once a month.
tools.mentor.signal_ide_adv: Go back to your best video and list 5 direct daughters of it. Too new an idea pays explanation tax.
tools.mentor.signal_pos_adv: Choose a sub-territory where you can be number 1 in 90 days and make a series of 5 videos about it.
tools.mentor.niche_uncalibrated_note: (niche not yet calibrated — the opinion comes out generic without this)
tools.mentor.case_empty_note: (describe the situation for a specific reading)
tools.mentor.exit_criteria_body: Run the test for 14 days or 4 videos. If the metric doesn't move, the hypothesis was wrong — not the effort.
tools.mentor.friendly_summary: Strategic opinion with model "{title}" ({group}) · Structured 3-step action plan
tools.mentor.title: AI Mentor
tools.mentor.lede: It's not a chat: it's an office with 24 mental models. Choose the framework, describe the situation and receive an opinion with lens, case reading, three-step plan and exit criteria.
tools.mentor.school_desc: The 24 frameworks synthesize public standards from these creators and strategists, rewritten as questions applicable to your channel.
tools.mentor.case_placeholder: Ex.: CTR 3%, retention 32%, channel stuck at 8 thousand subscribers, 2 videos per week.
tools.wiki.title: Dashboard Wiki
tools.wiki.lede: Each tool explains how it works inside: what goes in, what the panel calculates and what comes out. Read before complaining about the result.
tools.wiki.guide_1_d: Without niche, tops and flops, every tool returns generic text.
tools.wiki.guide_2_d: Ideas below 6 do not deserve a day of production.
tools.wiki.guide_3_d: Title and thumb define the script, not the other way around.
tools.wiki.guide_4_d: Below 40, the post returns to the bench.

tools.calib.profiles_desc: You can register several profiles (e.g. main channel, cuts, secondary channel). The profile marked as ACTIVE serves as a parameter for responses and suggestions from all other tools.
tools.calib.active_profile_desc: Responses and suggestions from all StudioOS tools are configured based on "{name}".

tools.rank.lede: Ruler from 0 to 10 calibrated on your channel. Five criteria, fixed weights, zero guesswork: the idea passes, adjusts or dies before you spend a day recording.
tools.rank.login_desc: Sign in to check and restore your analyses.
tools.rank.each_analysis_log: each analysis becomes a record here
tools.rank.next_step_desc: An approved idea becomes packaging. Take the theme straight to the title and hook.
tools.rank.input_card_title: Describe the idea of the video
tools.rank.input_placeholder: Ex.: I stopped investing R$100 in FIIs and the result was worse than savings
tools.rank.fit_explanation: Channel Fit measures the overlap between the idea words and the niche vocabulary declared here.
tools.rank.weights_info: weights: pool 26% · test 20% · connection 18% · fit 20% · outlier 16%
tools.receita.part_hook_role: First line: statement that breaks expectations, without warming up.
tools.receita.part_context_role: Two lines of scenery. Just what is necessary for the number to make sense.
tools.receita.part_turn_role: The error or discovery in 1st person. Here lies the affinity.
tools.receita.part_proof_role: Data, print, list or example that can be checked.
tools.receita.part_cta_role: A small, immediate action + invitation to comment.
tools.receita.recipe_step1: I cut {low} and didn't regret it.
tools.receita.recipe_step2: That's when {audience} realized that the cost was fixed and invisible.
tools.receita.recipe_step3: I thought {short} was necessary. It was habit.
tools.receita.recipe_step4: {input} shows the number: add it all up for 12 months before deciding.
tools.receita.recipe_step5: Make that count today. Comment on the value that I can help you interpret.
tools.receita.guardrail_body: Mirror the structure, not the content. The recipe worked because one day it seemed fresh.
tools.receita.friendly_summary: Viral structure deconstructed in 5 steps · Tom {tone} adapted to the new theme
tools.receita.title: Viral Recipe
tools.receita.lede: Reverse engineering: paste a post you performed, the panel extracts structure, tone and rhythm — and returns the same recipe applied to your theme, with the input that only you have.
tools.receita.honest_guardrail_desc: Viral recipe works because one day it seemed fresh. Do not run it without stopping.
tools.receita.original_placeholder: Paste the post you performed, in its entirety, with line breaks
tools.receita.what_tell: what are you going to tell
tools.receita.exclusive_expl: The exclusive input is what prevents copying: data, print, history or access that no other creator in the niche has.
tools.roteiro.fill_script: Fill in the script to see the text here.
tools.roteiro.block_hook_example: Two years. R$100 per month. And my balance was less than my savings. Look at this extract.
tools.roteiro.block_context_example: I started investing in FIIs in 2023 because everyone was talking about monthly income. But no one showed the real income.
tools.roteiro.block_dev_example:
First mistake: I chose a fund based on its dividend yield. Second mistake: I ignored the vacancy. Third mistake: I invested every month without looking at the quota price. Here on the screen is the spreadsheet with the three years.
When I switched to a straight treasury mix with a good brick FII, the result changed. He didn't become rich, he became honest.
tools.roteiro.block_cta_example: If you contribute R$100 per month, you will do this before the next contribution. And comment 100 and I'll bring you the migration step by step.
tools.roteiro.friendly_summary: Ready script with {words} words (~{duration} min of speech) · Quality checklist: {score} out of 4 approved
tools.roteiro.title: Script & Recording
tools.roteiro.lede: Three tabs: voice engine, block script and teleprompter. The final text comes out with a word count, estimated duration and a quality checklist actually applied to what you wrote.
tools.roteiro.sample_placeholder: Paste your transcription here, or a text you would write without proofreading
tools.roteiro.provokes_desc: Defines the limit of humor: how far the provocation goes before it becomes a gratuitous attack.
tools.roteiro.cta_desc: The phrase that ends every video. Repetition builds commenting habit.
tools.roteiro.prompter_note: The teleprompter reads the script assembled in the Blocks tab. Edit there and come back here.
tools.roteiro.setup_3: Look into the lens, not the screen
tools.roteiro.setup_4: Record 3 takes of the hook before the rest
tools.roteiro.recording_call_ph: Ex.: Take 01 — name of the video
tools.score.title: Post Score
tools.score.lede: Score from 0 to 50 on five criteria, calculated on the text you pasted — not on a printout. Over 40 publishes. Below that, the panel points out exactly which criterion dropped the grade.
tools.score.placeholder: Paste the entire post, with the line breaks as it is published
tools.thumb.slot_detail_default: Print or proof object with evident number
tools.thumb.default_expression_sample: Half-body, gaze directed towards the extract, expression of restrained alertness
tools.thumb.default_expression: Expression aligned with the tone of the video
tools.thumb.default_top_thumbs:
Statement print + face on the right
Graph falling + neutral expression
tools.thumb.comp_neutral: Cover without text. It works great when the visual element is self-explanatory.
tools.thumb.comp_warning: Long text (more than 4 words). On YouTube's mobile feed, excessive words reduce readability and clickability.
tools.thumb.comp_alert: Attention: The thumb is repeating the title of the video. The title delivers the rational promise; the thumb should open a gap of complementary curiosity.
tools.thumb.comp_success: Excellent! Concise supporting text with high curiosity gap potential.
tools.thumb.readability_desc: The element must be understood in 1 second on a 300px screen.
tools.thumb.safety_zones_desc: Keep a 15% free margin in the bottom right corner (where YouTube projects the duration timecode).
tools.thumb.pos_faceless: No face on this cover (100% focus on element/interface)
tools.thumb.pos_right: Half-length cutout on the right third
tools.thumb.pos_left: Half-length cutout on the left third
tools.thumb.rim_desc: Clipping light in color {color} to separate the creator from the dark background.
tools.thumb.golden_rule_camera: Always compose on top of the real photo. Never replace or regenerate your face with AI.
tools.thumb.no_cover_text: NO TEXT ON COVER — PURE VISUAL FOCUS
tools.thumb.hierarchy_desc: Bold/black sans serif typography, high contrast, without overlapping the focal element.
tools.thumb.complementarity_desc: Do not repeat the words in the video title.
tools.thumb.contrast_desc: High contrast between subject, element and background.
tools.thumb.sec_6: 6. HISTORY OF THUMBS WITH HIGH CTR ON THE CHANNEL
tools.thumb.title: Briefing Thumbnail
tools.thumb.lede: CTR visual engineering: composition using real archetypes, curiosity gap validation and executable briefing for designer or AI, free from rigid dogmas.
tools.thumb.principle_1_span: The thumbnail and title form a two-part story. The thumb never repeats the title.
tools.thumb.principle_2_span: On a small cell phone screen, the viewer needs to understand the subject without reading anything.
tools.thumb.principle_3_span: Isolates the subject from the dark background and ensures that the image does not become a gray mass.
tools.thumb.principle_4_span: YouTube timecode covers about 15% of the bottom right corner on mobile and desktop.
tools.thumb.golden_rule_desc: Never replace your face with AI. YouTube audiences click on trust and real human expression. Use AI only to generate backgrounds, objects or textures.
tools.thumb.default_video_title_mobile: Video title optimized for the YouTube algorithm
tools.thumb.audit_copy_good: Excellent: the text is short enough to be read in a fraction of a second as the user scrolls through the feed.
tools.thumb.audit_copy_warn: Attention: long texts become visual noise on cell phones. Keep it to 1 to 4 words.
tools.thumb.audit_copy_none: No text on the cover: the entire conversion will depend on the strength of the visual element and the title.
tools.thumb.audit_highlight_desc: The clipping outline in {color} ensures that the silhouette or object ({slot}) does not disappear into the dark background of mobile YouTube.
tools.thumb.audit_blindzone_desc: YouTube's official time badge overlays the bottom right corner. Make sure in the mockup that faces or critical texts are not in this area.
tools.thumb.audit_gap_desc: The thumbnail draws sensory attention; the title explains the value proposition. Together, they generate the urgency to click on the feed.
tools.thumb.topic_hint: context and title of the video
tools.thumb.topic_ph: Ex: How to start investing in 2026, Complete analysis...
tools.thumb.cover_text_ph: Ex: DON’T DO THIS, R$0 TO R$10k...
tools.thumb.element_eye_hint: what the eye looks for first
tools.thumb.element_detail_ph: Ex: Print of bank statement with falling income and red arrow pointing...
tools.thumb.video_topic_ph: Ex: FIIs with R$100 are no longer worth it
tools.thumb.expression_ph: Ex: Half body, staring at the graph, furrowed eyebrows...
tools.titulos.p1_title: I stopped {low} — and the results appeared in {n1} months
tools.titulos.p1_why: Confession with a deadline creates an open loop that can only be closed by watching.
tools.titulos.p2_title_anchor: {topic} is no longer worth it (and {anchor} explains)
tools.titulos.p2_why: It contradicts the common sense of the niche and signals new information.
tools.titulos.p3_title: I wasted {n2} years on {low}. What would I do differently
tools.titulos.p3_why: Own error = proof of honesty, and reduces fear of clicking.
tools.titulos.p4_title: {n1} better alternatives than {low} starting with R$100
tools.titulos.p4_why: Number on the front, clear deliverables and low barrier to entry.
tools.titulos.p5_title: Nobody told you this about {low} before {year}
tools.titulos.p5_why: Curiosity with a deadline: it works as an alert, not as a lesson.

tools.titulos.title: Title Generator
tools.titulos.lede: Five packaging patterns applied to your theme, calibrated by the titles that have already performed on the channel. Each output comes with the ruler: why it works and how much it should move the CTR.
tools.titulos.vocab_desc: Words repeated in your winning videos are ones your audience already recognizes. The generator injects the most frequent in at least one variant.
tools.titulos.flops_desc: Common Pattern: Title that describes the content rather than promising a consequence.
tools.titulos.topic_placeholder: Ex.: investing R$100 per month in FIIs

home.manifesto.step1_desc: Every output comes with a note and visible ruler.
home.manifesto.step2_desc: Always against your record, never against the average.

tools.membros.status_high: high target for current base size
tools.rank.why_pool_nomoney: No universal interest (money, time, status). Low ceiling.
tools.rank.why_proof_yes: There is something that can be shown on the screen — retention goes up.
tools.rank.why_proof_no: Nothing visible on the screen. Add print, extract, graph or live test.
tools.rank.why_connection_first: 1st person + consequence: sounds like history, not class.
tools.rank.why_connection_nofirst: 1st person missing. Swap “how to do it” for “what happened to me”.
tools.rank.why_fit_no_overlap: Outside the vocabulary of the calibrated niche.
tools.rank.why_fit_not_calibrated: Calibrate the niche to truly measure the fit.
tools.rank.why_outlier_tension: There is tension/confession — it breaks the feed pattern.
tools.rank.why_outlier_notension: Too predictable. Add a break from expectation.
tools.rank.why_empty_crit: Add an idea to evaluate this criterion.
tools.rank.verdict_ultra_note: Put it at the front of the recording queue.
tools.rank.verdict_good_note: One criterion pulls the average down. Correct before recording.
tools.rank.verdict_warm_note: The theme may work, the angle may not. Change the variable.
tools.rank.verdict_weak_note: Low ceiling and no proof. Return to the idea bank.
tools.score.fix_hook_has_num: Number present in the opening — hold that ruler.
tools.score.fix_hook_no_num: Put a raw number on the first line.
tools.score.fix_voice_monotone: Sentences all the same size. Alternate: a short one after a long one.
tools.score.fix_value_short: Too dense for the format. Add a concrete example.
tools.score.ev_structure: {lines} lines · {paras} paragraph(s) · longest block with {longest} words
tools.score.fix_structure_break: Break the longest paragraph: scannability drops on mobile.
tools.score.fix_readiness_clean: No AI cliché. You can press publish.
tools.score.verdict_ready_note: Above the cutoff of 40. Publish and measure in 48h.
tools.score.verdict_almost_note: One or two criteria hold the grade. Correct the one with the lowest score.
tools.score.verdict_rewrite_note: Weak structure. Go back to hook and reorganize into blocks.
tools.score.verdict_dont_publish_note: It's still a draft. There is a lack of thesis, proof and rhythm.

tools.wiki.entries.rank.title: Idea Rank
tools.wiki.entries.rank.lede: 0-10 scoring system to validate video ideas before recording.
tools.wiki.entries.rank.how: First you calibrate the tool by informing the channel's niche. Then type your video idea. The panel evaluates 5 essential criteria.
tools.wiki.entries.titulos.title: Title Generator
tools.wiki.entries.titulos.lede: Creating click-optimized (CTR) titles based on viral patterns.
tools.wiki.entries.titulos.how: You enter the main subject of the video and the tool applies proven frameworks on YouTube. The result is options focused on curiosity, clear benefit or breaking expectations.
tools.wiki.entries.hooks.title: Hook Generator
tools.wiki.entries.hooks.lede: Scripts for the first seconds of the video that instantly capture attention.
tools.wiki.entries.hooks.how: Offers 6 different approaches in up to 2 lines. Ideal for Shorts, Reels, TikTok or to ensure retention when introducing long videos.
tools.wiki.entries.thumbnail.title: Briefing Thumbnail
tools.wiki.entries.thumbnail.lede: Visual guidance for designers or for creating magnetic covers yourself.
tools.wiki.entries.thumbnail.how: The tool structures the visual composition of the thumbnail: scene elements, characters and expressions, palette, fonts and the exact text that goes in the image.
tools.wiki.entries.thumbnail.bullets.3: Golden rule: never regenerate your face
tools.wiki.entries.roteiro.title: Script & Teleprompter
tools.wiki.entries.roteiro.lede: Complete module for writing and recording with fluid reading on the screen.
tools.wiki.entries.roteiro.how: Divided into tabs: first you define the Channel Voice (rhythm, tone, jargon). Then you structure the script into blocks — Hook, Context, Development and CTA. When finished, open the Teleprompter, adjust the speed and record.
tools.wiki.entries.humanizador.title: Humanizing
tools.wiki.entries.humanizador.how: If the text came out of ChatGPT or Claude, paste it here. The Humanizer detects AI spoken words, analyzes the variation in sentence length (burstiness) and suggests cuts to make reading natural and rhythmic.
tools.wiki.entries.receita.title: Viral Recipe
tools.wiki.entries.receita.lede: Reverse engineering content that has already worked in your niche or outside of it.
tools.wiki.entries.receita.how: You provide the text of a post that performed very well. The tool extracts the base structure, emotional tone and pattern, and allows you to apply the same recipe to your theme without looking like a copy.
tools.wiki.entries.score.title: Post Score
tools.wiki.entries.score.lede: Final rating from 0 to 50 before hitting the Publish button.
tools.wiki.entries.score.how: Analyzes your draft and gives an objective score on 5 criteria. Above 40, it is ready for publication.
tools.wiki.entries.mentor.title: AI Mentor (24 FW)
tools.wiki.entries.mentor.lede: 24-hour consultancy based on 24 creative and business mental models.
tools.wiki.entries.mentor.how: Unlike a normal chat, Mentor AI evaluates your questions using frameworks from great content strategists. Ask for help to unravel an editorial line, resolve packaging or diagnose retention.
tools.wiki.entries.membros.title: Members Area
tools.wiki.entries.membros.lede: Planning and structuring courses and closed deliverables.
tools.wiki.entries.membros.how: Section focused on teaching architecture: organizing infoproduct content, planning modules, scripting dense classes, listing support materials and ensuring that the student's journey fulfills the promise of transformation.
tools.mentor.fw.01.title: Confidence curve
tools.mentor.fw.01.question: How much does the public already trust you — and what does this curve allow you to ask for now?
tools.mentor.fw.01.lens: Trust is capital. Spend a little per video, replace it with proof.
tools.mentor.fw.01.output.0: Map of current level of trust
tools.mentor.fw.01.output.2: Proof to show in the video
tools.mentor.fw.02.title: Ceiling of spectators
tools.mentor.fw.02.question: How many people in the world would be interested in this topic, at most?
tools.mentor.fw.02.lens: If the ceiling is low, the video is too niche for the algorithm to push.
tools.mentor.fw.02.output.2: When to accept a low ceiling
tools.mentor.fw.03.title: The algorithm has changed
tools.mentor.fw.03.question: What fell into your channel: distribution, packaging or interest?
tools.mentor.fw.03.lens: Algorithm is an audience mirror. Don't fight with the mirror.
tools.mentor.fw.04.title: Video flopped: diagnosis
tools.mentor.fw.04.question: Was it click (CTR) or was it retention?
tools.mentor.fw.04.lens: Low CTR = bundling. Low retention = unfulfilled promise.
tools.mentor.fw.05.title: View Meter I
tools.mentor.fw.05.question: How many views would this topic have on a channel 10× larger than yours?
tools.mentor.fw.05.lens: Compare to the niche ceiling, not your average.
tools.mentor.fw.06.title: View Meter II
tools.mentor.fw.06.question: What was your best recent performance — and what do they have in common?
tools.mentor.fw.06.lens: Your outlier is the best brief there is.
tools.mentor.fw.07.title: Multiplier effect
tools.mentor.fw.07.question: Which video can turn into 5 other videos without extra effort?
tools.mentor.fw.07.lens: A well-engraved pillar yields cuts, Shorts, post and class.
tools.mentor.fw.08.title: Specialization curve
tools.mentor.fw.08.question: Are you too spread out to be remembered for anything?
tools.mentor.fw.08.lens: Authority comes from repetition with variation.
tools.mentor.fw.09.title: Video variables
tools.mentor.fw.09.question: Theme, angle, format and proof — which ones did you change this time?
tools.mentor.fw.09.lens: Change one variable at a time or you learn nothing.
tools.mentor.fw.10.title: YouTube Ikigai
tools.mentor.fw.10.question: What you love, you know, the world wants to see and pays for — where does it cross?
tools.mentor.fw.10.lens: Outside of the crossover, the channel dies out of boredom or lack of demand.
tools.mentor.fw.11.title: Ikigai Video
tools.mentor.fw.11.question: Is this specific video at the intersection of the 4 circles?
tools.mentor.fw.11.lens: Apply Ikigai per video, not just per channel.
tools.mentor.fw.12.title: Creator Ikigai
tools.mentor.fw.12.question: What breeding routine can you sustain for 3 years without burning out?
tools.mentor.fw.12.lens: Consistency is a consequence of design, not discipline.
tools.mentor.fw.13.title: Brand Ikigai
tools.mentor.fw.13.question: What promise does your brand make when you're not in the room?
tools.mentor.fw.13.lens: Brand is what remains when the video ends.
tools.mentor.fw.14.title: Aura, the 4 A
tools.mentor.fw.14.question: Authority, Affinity, Authenticity and Reach — which one is weak?
tools.mentor.fw.14.lens: The 4 As explain why some grow and others just accumulate views.
tools.mentor.fw.15.title: Anatomy of a hook
tools.mentor.fw.15.question: In the first 3 seconds is there thesis, number and tension?
tools.mentor.fw.15.lens: Hook is not an introduction. Hook is the immediate delivery of gold.
tools.mentor.fw.16.title: Order of importance
tools.mentor.fw.16.question: Packaging, retention or production — where to invest now?
tools.mentor.fw.16.lens: Wrong investment order is the #1 reason for a stagnant channel.
tools.mentor.fw.17.title: Best social network
tools.mentor.fw.17.question: Where does your format yield more with the same effort?
tools.mentor.fw.17.lens: One main network, one cutoff, one text. Nothing more.
tools.mentor.fw.18.title: Creative block
tools.mentor.fw.18.question: Is it a lack of ideas, lack of repertoire or fear of judgment?
tools.mentor.fw.18.lens: Blocking is almost never creative. It's about decision or exposure.
tools.mentor.fw.19.title: Three-act structure
tools.mentor.fw.19.question: Are the thesis, escalation and deliverable clear in your roadmap?
tools.mentor.fw.19.lens: Three acts even work in a 60-second video.
tools.mentor.fw.20.title: 4 video levers
tools.mentor.fw.20.question: Idea, title, thumb or rhythm — which lever to pull first?
tools.mentor.fw.20.lens: Pull one lever per cycle and measure.
tools.mentor.fw.21.title: Content Trinity
tools.mentor.fw.21.question: Does video educate, entertain, or inspire — and does all three?
tools.mentor.fw.21.lens: Content that only makes one of the three has a low ceiling.
tools.mentor.fw.22.title: Scientific method
tools.mentor.fw.22.question: What hypothesis are you testing in this video?
tools.mentor.fw.22.lens: Channel is laboratory: hypothesis, test, reading, adjustment.
tools.mentor.fw.23.title: Value formula
tools.mentor.fw.23.question: Density × relevance ÷ viewer effort — how much does it give?
tools.mentor.fw.23.lens: Value is what remains after the cost of watching has been paid.
tools.mentor.fw.24.title: Niche within a niche
tools.mentor.fw.24.question: What sub-territory can you dominate before scaling up?
tools.mentor.fw.24.lens: Being #1 in a small niche pays more than being #40 in a large one.
